system.name: AGS
system.one_liner: an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that accelerates 3DGS-SLAM by exploiting cross-frame covisibility

components.name: Previous Frame
components.role: prior video frame supplying macro-blocks for matching

components.name: Current Frame
components.role: incoming video frame matched against the previous frame

components.name: Macro-Block Matching
components.role: CODEC motion-estimation step that finds minimum-SAD matching macro-blocks across frames

components.name: SAD Accumulation
components.role: sums minimum SAD values across all macro-blocks to produce frame covisibility

components.name: Coarse-Grained Pose Estimation (A)
components.role: neural-network-based (feature extraction + ConvGRU) fast pose estimate run for every frame

components.name: Fine-Grained Pose Refinement (B)
components.role: additional 3DGS training iterations that refine the pose when covisibility is below Thresh_T

components.name: Key Frame: Full Mapping (C)
components.role: runs baseline 3DGS mapping and records per-Gaussian contribution information

components.name: Non-Key Frame: Selective Mapping (D)
components.role: reuses recorded contribution information to skip non-contributory Gaussians

flows.what: coarse pose, refined when covisibility < Thresh_T
frame covisibility used for key/non-key frame designation

content.key_idea: AGS derives frame covisibility for free from video-CODEC motion estimation, then uses it to gate both a coarse-vs-fine pose tracking path and a full-vs-selective Gaussian mapping path, skipping unnecessary computation on highly similar frames.
content.reading_order: Left to right across three linked panels: frame covisibility detection, then movement-adaptive tracking, then Gaussian contribution-aware mapping.

summary: This figure gives the algorithm-level overview of AGS across three linked panels. The first panel shows frame covisibility detection: macro-blocks from the previous and current frame are matched via the video CODEC's motion estimation, and their minimum SAD values are accumulated into a frame covisibility score. The second panel, movement-adaptive tracking, always runs a lightweight neural-network coarse pose estimate (A) and conditionally follows it with a fine-grained 3DGS pose refinement (B) when covisibility falls below a threshold. The third panel, Gaussian contribution-aware mapping, designates key frames that run full mapping and record per-Gaussian contribution (C), and non-key frames that reuse that record to skip non-contributory Gaussians in selective mapping (D). The figure mixes vector icons, neural-network block diagrams and Gaussian ellipsoid sketches in a dense, small-font, three-panel layout.
summary_zh: 该图展示AGS算法总览，分三部分：帧协同可见性检测（宏块匹配与SAD累加得到协同可见性）、运动自适应跟踪（粗粒度位姿估计A，必要时精细化B）、高斯贡献感知建图（关键帧全量建图C记录贡献信息，非关键帧选择性建图D跳过非贡献高斯）。
